subscription_event_amount_check.name: subscription_event_amount_check
subscription_event_amount_check.value:
(
        "subscription_event"."type" in ('started', 'renewed', 'paymentFailed')
        and "subscription_event"."amount" = 500
      ) or (
        "subscription_event"."type" in ('cancelScheduled', 'ended')
        and "subscription_event"."amount" is null
      )

subscription_event_period_check.name: subscription_event_period_check
subscription_event_period_check.value: "subscription_event"."period_start" is null or "subscription_event"."period_end" is null or "subscription_event"."period_start" < "subscription_event"."period_end"
